Multi-step task nudge

UserPromptSubmit sub-hook · advisory only · silenced for the whole session by the first TaskCreate

Try the detector

Paste a prompt. This runs the hook's real regexes.
What the hook does
Why a sandbox. The dead hook this replaces (task-existence-gate) was never registered and, even wired, would have been silent for every ordinary session. Paste a case and see what actually happens instead of trusting the description.

The pipeline

  prompt lands
      |
      v
  3+ step shape AND session has no tasks?
      |-- no  -> silent
      |-- yes -> advisory [task-nudge #N]        (1st, then every 6th;
      |          never blocks                     explicit todo asks
      v                                           are never throttled)
  TaskCreate happens
      |
      v
  TaskCreated event (CC-native, shipped 2.1.84)
  logs session_id -> nudge goes SILENT for the session
      |
      v
  Stop: task-nudge-outcomes.jsonl, max 2 lines/session
  (qualifying_prompts x tasks_used) -> the rule's first denominator
Advisory on purpose. TaskCreated has supported blocking since 2.1.89. None of it is used here: a blocking task gate trains the --no-verify reflex, and the sibling precedent (visual-style-nudge, same dispatcher) shows a throttled advisory re-anchor changes behaviour on a real operator.

Why the obvious fix was a no-op

  task-existence-gate.ts (2026-03)   this hook (2026-08)
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreToolUse[Agent] spawns only      every prompt, at submit time
  exempts Explore, general-purpose,  no agent-type exemptions --
    Plan, claude-code-guide,           it never looks at agents
    statusline-setup, background
  blocks inside active pipelines     never blocks anything
  own hooks.json entry (never        sub-hook of an ALREADY-LIVE
    added -> dead since March)         dispatcher: no new wiring
  no measurement                     Stop-side telemetry
